title: The leak scan and the query-log redaction pass a real password behind a placeholder-looking user, since the userinfo user class bans angle brackets
goal: kbcommon.structured_secrets reports and redact.redact masks a url whose user part holds angle-bracket pieces and whose password is no whole placeholder; URL_USERINFO_ANGLE is defined once in kbcommon.py and redact.py imports it

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon as k;lt,gt,at=chr(60),chr(62),chr(64);u='https://'+lt+'user'+gt+':Pwd9xQ7'+at+'host/p';r=k.structured_secrets(u);print(r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)
